comment: Role override file for Issue #78 portfolio migration. The migration script consumes this to populate `portfolio_project.role` for legacy projects whose role is explicitly grounded in repository-controlled docs (domain.md §8, §9, §10). Rows that are NOT in this map leave `role` NULL — owner MUST provide an entry before publication is approved. The map is intentionally conservative: only the entries that domain.md names verbatim are grounded; facet/title heuristics are forbidden (AGENTS.md §3 / Issue #78 blocker #2).
